title: Object-property organization across visual ROIs
disposition_reason: The only delivered runtime body is a declaration for a full-three-person public-input investigation. All selected responses are intentionally public and its numerical grader is absent; public-support admission cannot establish numerical correctness or prediction on unseen outcomes.

scientific_target.question: On the declared public three-person panel, what cross-validated incremental relationship do animacy/size norms have with independently selected visual-ROI responses beyond fixed image-feature controls?
scientific_target.known_answer: Recomputed participant/ROI cross-validated variance contrasts from the permitted measurements and fixed model/fold definitions, including null or negative effects.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Measured THINGS-fMRI responses plus source object-property norms; the evaluator must recompute from data rather than score agreement with a paper narrative.
scientific_target.case_unit: A complete per-person public-response investigation with all ROI/contrast outputs.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Three people; shared concepts and within-person ROIs are crossed/dependent support.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Transparent numerical investigation of an exposed finite dataset. Internal held-out folds assess a specified estimator, while unrestricted access to all responses prevents calling the actor evaluation hidden-outcome prediction.
exclusions: No held-person or new-exemplar external prediction claim from the full3 all-public condition.
No causal category/ROI mechanism or native neural understanding from arithmetic/source reconstruction alone.

inputs: Declared 1,200 response/property rows per person, all three people, selected ROI response matrices, image features and property norms.
Public split definitions for 15 folds per person and all four fixed comparison models, once recovered.
forbidden_inputs: No future hidden evaluation packet may be inferred from this public-input design.
Answer-key effect tables or scorer-produced contrast values cannot substitute for independently computed participant artifacts.
observation_contract.case_identity: The manifest identifies people 01,02,03 and 1,200 rows/person; exact row, concept and ROI identifiers are not present in the delivered manifest.
observation_contract.split: Declared 15 folds/person must be recovered and checked for concept/repetition grouping. Since all outcomes are intentionally public, distinguish cross-validation inside the submitted analysis from a genuinely held-out evaluation of the analyst.
observation_contract.coverage: Declared 3,600 rows, four fixed models and 1,000 shared concept draws across three people; no complete numerical source or authentic execution accompanies these counts.

primary.name: Absolute error in independently recomputed held-out incremental variance contrasts
primary.aggregation: Report each ROI/property contrast for every person, then equal-person average within each prespecified contrast; retain signed biological effect separately.
primary.rationale: For an all-public investigation, correctness is faithful recomputation, not rewarding a desired biological conclusion or overstating predictive generalization.

secondary: Signed property-minus-image-control variance gain and all fold denominators.
Independent review of uncertainty, nuisance adequacy and limitations; do not combine with arithmetic score until a reasoning rubric is qualified.

comparators.name: Fixed image-feature-only model
comparators.inputs: Prespecified image features and training-fold responses
comparators.procedure: Proposed independent nuisance fit using the recovered four-model protocol.

comparators.name: Image plus property model
comparators.procedure: Proposed independent augmented fit with training-only scaling/regularization.

comparators.name: Concept-label permutation
comparators.inputs: Whole concept groups, preserving within-concept rows
comparators.procedure: Proposed negative control refit under identical fold and ROI selection rules.

nuisance_controls: Independent ROI definition and training-only reliability matching.
Freeze property transformations and low-level image representation before reading effects.
Preserve all folds and null/negative results; prohibit selective ROI/concept deletion.
evaluation.uncertainty: Preserve paired-person effects and jointly resample shared concepts across people; three-person uncertainty is descriptive and not broad population evidence.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all prescribed numerical/model outputs and methods; public schema admission alone does not grade their values. Missing or contradictory contrast support makes that complete investigation unscorable.

implementation.scorer_target: Manifest explicitly says public-support admission without numerical grade; referenced producer/admission files are absent from the public task directory.

missing: Recover numerical recomputation and exact four-model/fold definitions.

implementation.execution_evidence: Manifest is proposed_source_registered_unqualified and status not_run; no numeric analysis or model trial was run here.
